### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 at half the price of Fable 5
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, delivering near-frontier performance at half the price of rival Claude Fable 5.

- Priced at $5/million input, $25/million output tokens — same as Opus 4.8
- Fable 5 costs $10/million input, $50/million output
- Scores 43.3% on Frontier-Bench v0.1 vs Fable 5's 33.7%
- 1M-token context window, 128K output tokens
- Safety classifiers intervene ~85% less often than Fable 5
- Includes effort dial and Fast mode (2.5x speed, 2x price)
